title: 第5章 飞花摘叶皆可为剑第6章 武极宗会武登武极殿
content_zh:
第一卷第5章飞花摘叶，皆可为剑！
“公子，他是真传弟子王珉，皇甫逸的心腹之人，实力很强，恐怕来者不善。”
雪儿神色紧张。
王珉在真传弟子当中也属于强者！
王珉身后，还有三人，其中一人正是赵拓！
另外两人是内宗天才，抬着赵拓过来的。
腿断了，抬也要给他抬过来。
赵拓被林尘打断了双腿，恨意滔天，反正有王珉坐镇，他要来看林尘被暴打！
“林尘，你肆意重伤同门，可知罪？”
王珉冷笑道。
“给我滚！”
林尘直接喝斥，接二连三来打扰他修炼，烦不胜烦！
真是修炼都不得清静！
看来，不给这些人一点颜色看看，他们不知道收敛！
“打伤同门，还敢如此狂妄，我作为师兄，今日必须好好教育你！”
王珉嘴角勾起一抹森然弧度，若是面对以前的林尘，他不敢放肆。
而现在，林尘武魂被废，沦为废人，王珉肆无忌惮。
“凭你，也配？”
“小子，我今天就废……”
王珉话还没说完，突然间，一股狂风吹来。

门外栽种着一株杨树，许多奇花异草。
风吹过。
落叶飘飞，花瓣凋零。
林尘一指点出，剑气生，落叶与花瓣突然卷起，化作一连串光影，速度快到不可思议！
“噗嗤！”
刹那间，血光爆出。
王珉直接跪了下去，膝盖出现两道血痕，血肉被切开，露出森森白骨，血流如注！
“你，竟然是剑师！”
王珉惊骇欲绝！
刚才，林尘竟然放出了剑气！
剑师，一念起，剑气生！
飞花摘叶，皆可为剑！
剑道修炼境界，分为剑士、剑师、剑宗、剑尊等。
剑道修行者，掌握一种基础剑法，就可称之为剑士。
剑士连剑道入门都算不上，只能称之为学徒。
剑师，精通各种剑法，甚至可释放剑气，杀人于无形！
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 5 Flying flowers and picking leaves can all be used as swords!
"Young master, he is Wang Min, the true disciple, Huangfu Yi's confidant. He is very powerful. I'm afraid the person who comes here is not good."
Xueer looked nervous.
Wang Min is also a strong one among the true disciples!
Behind Wang Min, there were three other people, one of whom was Zhao Tuo!
The other two were geniuses from the inner sect and carried Zhao Tuo over.
Even if his leg is broken, he has to carry it over.
Zhao Tuo had his legs broken by Lin Chen, and his hatred was overwhelming. Wang Min was here anyway, and he wanted to see Lin Chen being beaten!
"Lin Chen, you wantonly seriously injured a fellow disciple, do you think you are guilty?"
Wang Min sneered.
"Get out of here!"
Lin Chen directly scolded him and disturbed his practice one after another, which was very annoying!
It’s true that you can’t even practice in peace!
It seems that if you don’t give these people some color, they won’t know how to restrain themselves!
"You dare to be so arrogant after injuring a fellow disciple. As a senior brother, I must educate you well today!"
The corner of Wang Min's mouth curled up with a serious arc. If he faced Lin Chen from the past, he would not dare to be presumptuous.
But now, Lin Chen's martial spirit has been abolished and he has become a useless person, and Wang Min is acting unscrupulously.
"You deserve it?"
"Boy, I will be useless today..."
Before Wang Min finished speaking, suddenly, a strong wind blew.
There is a poplar tree planted outside the door, and many exotic flowers and plants.
The wind blows.
The fallen leaves are flying and the petals are withering.
As soon as Lin Chen pointed out his sword energy, the fallen leaves and petals suddenly rolled up and turned into a series of light and shadow, the speed was unbelievable!
"Pfft!"
In an instant, blood burst out.
Wang Min knelt down directly, and two blood marks appeared on his knees. The flesh and blood were cut open, revealing the dense white bones, and the blood flowed like a steady stream!
"You are actually a swordsman!"
Wang Min was horrified!
Just now, Lin Chen actually released his sword energy!
Sword Master, when you think of it, the sword energy comes into being!
Flying flowers and picking leaves can all be turned into swords!
The realm of swordsmanship training is divided into swordsmen, swordsmen, swordsmen, swordsmen, etc.
A swordsman who masters a basic sword technique can be called a swordsman.
A swordsman is not even an introduction to the art of swordsmanship, he can only be called an apprentice.
A swordsman who is proficient in various sword techniques and can even release sword energy to kill people invisible!
